ng of East)

Hand 007: ['1B', '1B', '2B', '2B', '3B', '3B', '4B', '4B', '5B', '5B', '6B', '6B', '7B']
This has 6 pairs already: [1B,1B], [2B,2B], [3B,3B], [4B,4B], [5B,5B], [6B,6B]
Plus one extra 7B
Can add one more 7B to make 7 pairs (Seven Pairs pattern)
Or can form chows: [1B,2B,3B], [4B,5B,6B], [7B,7B,7B] (with one more 7B)
So it can form both patterns

Hand 002: ['1D', '9D', '1B', '9B', '1C', '9C', 'East', 'South', 'West', 'North', 'Red', 'Green', 'White']
This has all 13 orphan tiles (terminals + honors)
Can add any orphan tile to make a duplicate
This forms the Thirteen Orphans pattern

Hand 003: ['1D', '3D', '5D', '7D', '9D', '2B', '4B', '6B', '8B', '1C', '3C', '5C', '7C']
This has odd tiles that don't form pairs or sequences:
1D, 3D, 5D, 7D, 9D, 2B, 4B, 6B, 8B, 1C, 3C, 5C, 7C
These are all odd-numbered tiles with gaps, can't form chows
Only has 1 of each tile, can't form pairs
Not enough pairs for Seven Pairs (only 0 pairs)
Missing some orphans for Thirteen Orphans
So this is correctly identified as 'Not a winning hand'

Hand 006: ['1D', '2D', '3D', '4B', '5B', '6B', '7C', '8C', '9C', 'East', 'East', 'South', 'South']
Current tiles: 1D,2D,3D (chow), 4B,5B,6B (chow), 7C,8C,9C (chow)
Plus East,East (pair) and South,South (another pair)
With 13 tiles, we have 3 chows + 2 pairs = 13 tiles
We need 4 sets + 1 pair = 14 tiles
So we need to convert one pair into a pung by adding one more East or South
This would give us: 3 chows + 1 pung + 1 pair = 4 sets + 1 pair
Correctly identified as Standard winning hand
